labels.rationale: `message$.get()` tracks the whole message to pass only `timestamp` and `metadata` to MessageMetaLabel, so the Memo reruns on every streamed token appended by `lastMessage$.content.set` (hooks/useConversation.ts:270). Leaf reads of the two fields remove those reruns.

The failed-message Memo reads the whole message to check `_status` and `_error`, so it reruns on every streamed token (hooks/useConversation.ts:270) although those fields change only in stores/conversations.ts:168-170.

The Memo reads `conversation$.data.log.get()`, which a child write notifies, so every streamed token reruns a backward scan for the last assistant model and rerenders OpenConversationPathButton; the streaming message has no metadata until completion, so the scan passes it on every token.

`use$(conversations$.get(conversationId))` subscribes the 1,400-line ChatInput to the whole ConversationState, including `data.log`, so it rerenders on every streamed token while reading only `isGenerating`, `executingTool` and `pendingTool` (883-888). The Map-entry binding is not proven, which blocks the leaf split.

The useMemo at 189-207 is keyed on `registry.servers`, but `updateServer` replaces an element in place (stores/servers.ts:336, called from settings/ServerConfiguration.tsx:174), which keeps the array's identity. Renaming the primary server rerenders MainLayout through `use$` while `serverName` in the memoized list stays stale. This is the same shape as the flagged hooks/useMultiServerConversations.ts:15, but the dependency is a member of the mutated object.

The useMemo reads `storeConversations$.get()` untracked and lists the stable computed handle as its dependency (291), so store-only conversations stay stale until another dependency changes. Subscribing with `use$` is not a safe fix: the computed at 236 rebuilds a fresh array from `conversations$.get()` on every streamed token.

The hook subscribes `isLoading` and `error` (90-91) for every caller, but SidebarIcons.tsx:107 uses only `data`. Each fetch toggles `isLoading` at 30 and 63, rerendering the always-mounted icon rail twice, and ServerProviderHealthSettings.tsx:28 polls every 30 s while open. The subscription sits in a custom hook whose consumer is the caller.
